blocks.title: Standard enthalpy change of combustion
blocks.text: Standard enthalpy change of combustion, delta Hc, woh enthalpy tabdeeli hai jab kisi madde ka ek mole standard halaat ke tehat zaid oxygen mein poori tarah jalaya jaye. Yeh hamesha exothermic hai.
Ethanol ki standard enthalpy of combustion -1368 kJ fi mol hai: C2H5OH(l) + 3O2(g) se 2CO2(g) + 3H2O(l). Combustion ki enthalpy tabdeeli khoraak aur fuels ka calorie content nikalne mein mufeed hai.

blocks.prompt: Methane, CH4, ki standard enthalpy of combustion ki tareef karne wala muadla likhein.
blocks.explanation: CH4(g) + 2O2(g) se CO2(g) + 2H2O(l), 298 K aur 1 atm par zaid oxygen mein poori tarah jale methane ke ek mole ke liye; us ka delta Hc manfi hai.

items: Delta Hc: standard halaat mein zaid oxygen mein ek mole poora jalna, hamesha exothermic (ethanol -1368 kJ fi mol); khoraak aur fuels ke calorie content ke liye istemal.
